+def pose_for_tcp(now, left=None, right=None, grip=None):
+    """Keep measured wrist orientation and convert desired TCP xyz to EE xyz."""
+    row = np.array(now[14:28], dtype=float)
+    l_offset = np.array(now[56:59]) - np.array(now[14:17])
+    r_offset = np.array(now[63:66]) - np.array(now[21:24])
+    if left is not None:
+        row[:3] = np.asarray(left) - l_offset
+    if right is not None:
+        row[7:10] = np.asarray(right) - r_offset
+    row = np.r_[row[:7], grip[0] if grip else now[28],
+                row[7:14], grip[1] if grip else now[29]]
+    return row

+
+def main():
